brief_summary: Pioglitazone and insulin glargine are equally effective in achieving glycemic control in secondary drug failure of type 2 diabetes but the mechanisms of actions are different.
brief_title: Pioglitazone vs. Insulin Glargine in the Treatment of Secondary Drug Failure in Type 2 Diabetes
collaborators: Skane County Council Research & Development Foundation

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* type 2 diabetes
* inadequately controlled on 50% of maximal-dose of an insulin secretagogue and metformin

Exclusion Criteria:

* heart failure (NYHA II-IV)

official_title: Differences in Metabolic and Cardiovascular Effects of Pioglitazone vs. Insulin Glargine in the Treatment of Secondary Drug Failure in Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: Effect of pioglitazone vs. insulin glargine on beta-cell function and insulin sensitivity
